The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -1.6531688150158277). This error typically indicates the use of unrecognized function names or invalid named ranges in the Excel formulas. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics matrix is broken.
